title: Russian hackers turn Kazuar backdoor into modular P2P botnet
summary: The Russian hacker group Secret Blizzard has developed its long-running Kazuar backdoor into a modular peer-to-peer (P2P) botnet designed for long-term persistence, stealth, and data collection. [...]
